latest_cos_commentary.headline: DIRECTV for Business is a commercial-TV/entertainment vendor to bars and restaurants, not a POS or payments platform.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: No direct overlap with Genius's pos, payments, back_office, kitchen_drive_thru, loyalty_engagement, or digital_menu_boards lines; DIRECTV sits in the facility-entertainment category, adjacent at most to digital signage budgets.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: DIRECTV expanded its 2026 sports rights lineup (F1, MLS, expanded Prime Video Sports) to stay competitive with streaming-first alternatives for the bar/restaurant TV segment.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Not a competitive-displacement conversation for RMs; if it comes up, it's a facility vendor comparison (sports package costs), not a POS/payments decision.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Do not treat DIRECTV as a POS/payments competitor in scoring or positioning material; its category tag in the tracker may need review.
